lessons.title: Present Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT (have/has + V3)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 1 – Present Perfect (jadval + kombinatsiya + mashqlar).
objectives: Present Perfect qolipini (have/has + V3) tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuza olish.
"ever / never / been to" bilan hayotiy tajriba haqida gapira olish.
20 ta hikoya fe'lining V1–V2–V3 shakllarini yoddan bilish (CORE).
Kombinatsiya: formula → gap → tarjima 1 daqiqada 4 marta.
materials: Narrative verbs (hikoya fe'llari, V1–V2–V3) CORE 20 varag'i.
timeline: "What have you done today?" — ustoz 3 o'quvchidan so'raydi, javoblarni doskaga yozadi (I have eaten…, I have come…).
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — IELTS 1.0 yakuni — Past Simple lug'ati
Kitob jadvali: Positive S+have/has+V3 → Negative haven't/hasn't+V3 → Question Have/Has+S+V3. Har qatorda misol + tarjima, keyin o'quvchi o'zi misol tuzadi.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Present Perfect — o'tgan zamonda bo'lgan, lekin natijasi HOZIR ko'rinadigan ish. Vaqt aytilmaydi: "I have lost my key" (kalitim yo'q — hozir).
Past Simple'dan farqi: Past Simple'da vaqt aniq (yesterday, in 2020), Present Perfect'da vaqt muhim emas — natija muhim.
have/has — yordamchi; asosiy fe'l 3-shaklda (V3). Regular: V+ed; irregular — jadvaldan yod olinadi (bugungi lug'at).
formulas: I have started my business recently.
Have you ever been to Tashkent?
have been to = borib kelgan; have gone to = ketgan (hali u yerda)
Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Has she called? — Yes, she has.
presentation: Have you ever broken a bone?
Yes, I have. I have broken my arm.
Has your teacher come?
No, she hasn't come yet.
What have you eaten today?
I have eaten plov.
Have they finished the test?
Yes, they have finished it.
Has he ever seen the sea?
No, he has never seen the sea.
Have you done your homework?
Yes, I have done it.
Where has Ali gone?
He has gone to the bank.
Have you been to Samarkand?
Yes, I have been there twice.
Has it rained today?
No, it hasn't rained.
How many books have you read this year?
I have read five books.
notes: Vaqt so'zi bo'lsa (yesterday, last week, ago, in 2019) — Past Simple, Present Perfect emas.
Present Perfect bilan yuradigan so'zlar: ever, never, just, already, yet, recently, so far, today, this week.
"been to" — borib qaytgan; "gone to" — hali qaytmagan. Ustoz doskada ikkita rasm bilan ko'rsatadi.
Irregular V3 — kombinatsiya bilan emas, lug'at bilan yodlanadi: bugungi CORE 20 shu maqsadda.
mistakes: Have you ever been in London?
Have you ever been TO London?
He has been to Paris, he isn't here.

how: CORE 20 — hikoyalarda eng ko'p uchraydigan irregular fe'llar (3 shakli bilan). STRONG +20 va SUPER +20 — kuchli o'quvchi uchun.
Har so'z: V1 – V2 – V3 aytiladi, so'ng Present Perfect gap: "I have ___". Ovoz chiqarib, xor bilan 2 marta.
Normativ: ustoz V1 aytadi — o'quvchi V2, V3 + tarjima.
core: She has bought a new phone.
He has eaten all the cake.
The child has fallen off the bike.
They have given me a present.
I have known her for years.
strong: Have you paid for the tickets?

She has read this book twice.
U bu kitobni ikki marta o'qigan.
Have you ever ridden a horse?
She has sung at a concert.
We have sat here for an hour.
Biz bu yerda bir soatdan beri o'tiribmiz.
Have you spoken to the boss?
I have spent all my money.
I have told you the truth.
Our team has won the match.
super: They have built a new bridge.
He has drawn a beautiful picture.
She has driven for ten years.
U o'n yildan beri mashina haydaydi.
I have never felt so happy.
Have you ever flown to Dubai?
The tree has grown a lot.
The cat has hidden under the bed.
I have kept all his letters.
He has lent me his laptop.
I have swum in the sea.
She has taught English for years.
U yillardan beri ingliz tili o'rgatadi.
He has thrown the ball away.
I have worn this shirt twice.
normativ: Og'zaki: CORE 20 so'z + tarjima + gap, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin.
Yozma (keyingi darsda): 20 so'z, 5 daqiqa — 2 coin. STRONG/SUPER — +2 / +3 coin.

reading.title: Sardor Rashidov — Uzbek goals he has scored
text: Sardor Rashidov was born in 1991 in Tashkent. He has played for Bunyodkor, Al-Jazira and Qatar SC, and he has scored more than 30 goals for the national team of Uzbekistan. Fans have called him "the magician" because of his dribbling.

Has he ever played in Europe? No, he hasn't. But he has beaten many European players in Asian competitions, and he has won the league in three countries. He has never given up: in 2019 he broke his leg, but he has come back and has played again for Uzbekistan.
"I have made mistakes and I have lost finals," he says, "but I have never stopped working." Young players have learned one thing from him: talent is not enough — you have to work every day.

answers: He has played for Bunyodkor, Al-Jazira and Qatar SC.

kahoot.q: I ___ my key. I can't open the door now.
kahoot.explain: Natija hozir (eshikni ocholmayman) → have + V3; lose – lost – lost.

kahoot.q: My brother has never ___ sushi.
kahoot.explain: has + V3: eat – ate – EATEN.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
kahoot.explain: She → HAS; asosiy fe'l V3 shaklda: finished.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: I have went to the market.
I have gone to the market.
We have bought a new car.
kahoot.explain: go – went – GONE: have + V3 → have gone. «have went» — xato.

kahoot.q: ___ you ever ___ to Samarkand?
kahoot.explain: Savol: Have + you + V3? «been to» = borib kelgan.

kahoot.q: Inkor shaklini tanlang: «We have finished the project.»
kahoot.explain: Inkor: haven't + V3; we → have.

kahoot.q: Has Aziz called you? — Yes, he ___.
kahoot.explain: Has…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, he has / No, he hasn't.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «U hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan.»
options: She has never flown on a plane.
She has never flew on a plane.
She have never flown on a plane.
She hasn't never flown on a plane.
kahoot.explain: She → has; never has va V3 orasida; fly – flew – FLOWN. Ikki inkor (hasn't never) — xato.

kahoot.q: Ali isn't here. He ___ to London. He comes back next week.
kahoot.explain: Hali qaytmagan (hozir u yerda) → has gone to. «has been to» = borib kelgan.

kahoot.q: I ___ him yesterday at school.
kahoot.explain: «yesterday» — vaqt aniq → Present Perfect emas, Past Simple: saw.

kahoot.q: Qaysi holatda Present Perfect ishlatiladi?
options: O'tgan ish, natijasi hozir muhim, vaqti aytilmagan
kahoot.explain: Present Perfect — o'tgan ish, lekin natija HOZIR muhim; vaqt aytilmaydi.

kahoot.q: So'z tartibi: ever / you / have / eaten / plov?
kahoot.explain: Savol: Have + S + ever + V3? → Have you ever eaten plov?

kahoot.q: write – wrote – ___
kahoot.explain: write – wrote – WRITTEN (noto'g'ri fe'l).
buy (sotib olmoq) – bought – bought. «brought» — bring (olib kelmoq) fe'lidan.

kahoot.q: Oops! I have ___ my glass. There is water on the floor.
kahoot.explain: have + V3: break – broke – BROKEN (sindirmoq).

kahoot.q: Antonim: find (topmoq) ↔ ?
kahoot.explain: find – topmoq, lose – yo'qotmoq (lost – lost).

kahoot.q: Our team has ___ the match! We are the champions!
kahoot.explain: win (yutmoq) – won – WON.

kahoot.q: «tark etmoq; qoldirmoq» — qaysi fe'l?
kahoot.explain: leave – left – left = tark etmoq, qoldirmoq. live — yashamoq.

kahoot.q: Which verb is the SAME in V1, V2 and V3?
kahoot.explain: put – put – put. take – took – taken, give – gave – given, speak – spoke – spoken.

kahoot.q: I have ___ this book three times. I love it!
kahoot.explain: read – read – read: yozilishi bir xil, V2/V3 [red] deb o'qiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT vs PAST SIMPLE (vaqt aniqmi — natijami?)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 2 – Present Perfect vs Past Simple (jadval, A–E mashqlar).
objectives: Vaqt ko'rsatkichiga qarab Past Simple yoki Present Perfect'ni to'g'ri tanlash.
Bir vaziyatni ikki zamon bilan ifodalash (I have lost it → I lost it yesterday).
Tug'ilish mavzusidagi 20 so'z bilan oila haqida gapira olish.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 5 marta.
timeline: "When did you come to Jony Academy?" (Past Simple) → "How many lessons have you had?" (Present Perfect). Ikkisi doskaga: qaysi birida vaqt bor?
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
Kitob jadvali: Past Simple — vaqt aniq (two minutes ago); Present Perfect — vaqt aytilmaydi, natija hozir. Har juft gapni yonma-yon yozib, "when?" so'rab tekshiriladi.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Past Simple: ish O'TGANDA bo'ldi va tugadi, VAQTI aniq (yesterday, ago, last…, in 2019, when I was…).
Present Perfect: ish o'tganda bo'ldi, lekin vaqt muhim emas; natija yoki tajriba HOZIR muhim (ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, today).
Suhbat qoidasi: birinchi savol Present Perfect ("Have you ever been to Dubai?"), tafsilot Past Simple ("When did you go? — I went in 2023").
formulas: I entered the room two minutes ago.
Have you ever…? → When did you…?
Have you ever been to Dubai? — Yes. — When did you go? — In 2023.
yesterday / last week / ago / in 2019 → Past Simple
today / this week / this year / so far → Present Perfect
She has called me twice today.
U bugun ikki marta qo'ng'iroq qildi.
I have lost my key. I can't get in.
presentation: Have you ever seen a newborn baby?
Yes, I have. I saw my cousin's baby last month.
When was your brother born?
He was born in 2015.
Has your aunt had her baby yet?
Yes, she has. She gave birth last week.
Did you visit them in hospital?
Yes, I visited them on Monday.
How many times have you been to a baby shower?
I have been to two.
What did you buy for the baby?
I bought a small blanket.
Have your parents chosen a name?
Yes, they have already chosen it.
Did the baby sleep well last night?
No, she cried all night.
Has the baby started walking?
Not yet. She has just started crawling.
When did you last hold a baby?
I held my nephew yesterday.
notes: "ago" faqat Past Simple bilan: two days ago — I met him two days ago.
"just / already / yet" — Present Perfect (Britaniya normasi). Amerikada Past Simple ham bo'ladi, imtihonda Present Perfect yozamiz.
"today / this week" — davr hali tugamagan → Present Perfect; "this morning" tushdan keyin aytilsa → Past Simple.
Savol "When…?" — har doim Past Simple ("When have you…?" bo'lmaydi).
mistakes: I lost my key, I can't get in.
I have lost my key. I can't get in.

how: CORE 20 — kitobning BIRTH WORDS ro'yxatidan eng zaruri. STRONG/SUPER — chaqaloq parvarishi va oila so'zlari.
Har so'z bilan: bitta Past Simple gap ("was born in…") va bitta Present Perfect gap.
core: The birth of a child changes everything.
I was born in Tashkent in 2008.
The baby has slept for three hours.
A newborn sleeps most of the day.
Yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloq kunning ko'p qismini uxlaydi.
Infants need milk every few hours.
Go'daklarga har necha soatda sut kerak.
Uning homiladorligi to'qqiz oy davom etdi.
She gave birth to twins last night.
Childbirth is hard work for the mother.
The midwife has helped hundreds of mothers.
She is on maternity leave now.
The twins were born in April.
The premature baby stayed in hospital.
We have organised a baby shower.
It's a boy! / It's a girl!
ɪts ə bɔɪ!  ɪts ə gərl!
Birth is the miracle of life.
strong: The baby has fallen asleep in the cradle.
We bought a cot last week.
Biz o'tgan hafta bolalar karavoti oldik.
She pushed the pram to the park.
They bottle-feed the baby at night.
She has breastfed for six months.
U olti oy ko'krak suti bilan boqdi.
The baby has started to crawl.
He took his first steps yesterday.
The toddler has learned ten words.
We have received the birth certificate.
Her first birthday was last Sunday.
Uning birinchi tug'ilgan kuni o'tgan yakshanba edi.
The baby weighed 3.5 kilos at birth.
Ular unga Amir deb ism qo'yishdi.
We have painted the nursery blue.
They are expecting a baby in June.
super: They adopted a baby girl in 2020.
Asrab olish bir yil davom etdi.
The orphan has found a new family.
She hopes for a natural birth.
We prayed for a safe delivery.
Biz eson-omon tug'ishini so'rab duo qildik.
Three generations live in our house.
He is a descendant of a famous poet.
The birth rate has fallen in Europe.
Has the baby had her vaccinations?
The paediatrician has checked the baby.
A new baby has come into the world.
She has brought three children into the world.
I have drawn my family tree.
normativ: Og'zaki: CORE 20 so'z + tarjima + gap, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin.
Yozma (keyingi darsda): 20 so'z, 5 daqiqa — 2 coin. STRONG/SUPER — +2 / +3 coin.

kahoot.q: I ___ Dubai in 2023.
kahoot.explain: «in 2023» — vaqt aniq → Past Simple: visited.

kahoot.q: ___ you ever ___ a newborn baby in your arms?
kahoot.explain: «ever» — tajriba savoli → Present Perfect: Have you ever held…? (hold – held – held).

kahoot.q: When ___ you ___ in Tashkent?
kahoot.explain: «When» — vaqt so'raladi → Past Simple: When did you arrive?

kahoot.q: My sister ___ born in 2010.
kahoot.explain: Tug'ilish — har doim Past Simple: I was born, she was born.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: «yesterday» — tugagan vaqt → Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.

kahoot.q: Qaysi vaqt ifodasi Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladi?
kahoot.explain: so far, today, this week — tugamagan davr → PP. yesterday, ago, in 2019 → Past Simple.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Men kecha kechqurun unga qo'ng'iroq qildim.»
options: I have called her last night.
I have call her last night.
kahoot.explain: «last night» — tugagan vaqt → Past Simple: I called.

kahoot.q: Have you ever been to Dubai? — Yes. — When ___ you go?
kahoot.explain: Birinchi savol PP, tafsilot (qachon?) — Past Simple: When did you go?

kahoot.q: My aunt ___ a baby girl two weeks ago.
kahoot.explain: «ago» — aniq o'tgan vaqt → Past Simple: had.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: We have gone to Japan in 2020.
We have been to Japan in 2020.
We have went to Japan in 2020.
kahoot.explain: «in 2020» — aniq vaqt → Past Simple: We went.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Siz hech qachon sushi yeganmisiz?»
kahoot.explain: Tajriba savoli → Have you ever + V3? (eat – ate – eaten).

kahoot.q: ago, yesterday, last week bilan qaysi zamon ishlatiladi?
kahoot.explain: Aniq tugagan vaqt (ago, yesterday, last…) → Past Simple.

kahoot.q: A woman who helps mothers give birth is a ___.
kahoot.explain: midwife — doya, akusherka.

kahoot.q: Two babies born at the same time to one mother are ___.
kahoot.explain: twins — egizaklar.

kahoot.q: Collocation: to ___ birth to a baby
kahoot.explain: give birth — tug'moq: She gave birth to twins.

kahoot.q: A baby born before the due date is ___.
kahoot.explain: premature — vaqtidan oldin tug'ilgan. due date — tug'ish sanasi.

kahoot.q: A child of 1–3 years who is learning to walk is a ___.
kahoot.explain: toddler — endi yurayotgan bola (1–3 yosh).

kahoot.q: Mothers sing a ___ to help babies fall asleep.
kahoot.explain: lullaby — alla. cradle — beshik, nappy — tagliq, pram — aravacha.

kahoot.q: Before babies can walk, they ___ on the floor.
kahoot.explain: crawl — emaklamoq. Keyin first steps — ilk qadamlar.

kahoot.q: «pram / stroller» nima?
kahoot.explain: pram / stroller — bolalar aravachasi. cradle — beshik, cot — karavot.

lessons.title: Since vs For, Because + Present Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: HOW LONG? SINCE vs FOR; BECAUSE + PRESENT PERFECT
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 3 – How long: since vs for (jadval, mashqlar F–H, since/for 20 gap).
objectives: since (boshlanish nuqtasi) va for (davomiylik) farqini bilish va ishlatish.
"How long have you…?" savolini tuzish va to'liq javob berish.
"because + Present Perfect" bilan hozirgi holatning sababini aytish.
Nikoh mavzusidagi 20 so'z bilan oila tarixini aytib berish.
timeline: "How long have you studied English?" — javoblar doskaga: "since 2024" / "for two years". Qaysi biri boshlanish nuqtasi, qaysi biri davomiylik?
Kahoot — Present Perfect vs Past Simple
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Present Perfect vs Past Simple lug'ati
Kitob jadvali: SINCE + boshlangan vaqt, FOR + qancha davom etgani, BECAUSE + Present Perfect (sabab natija hozir), HOW LONG + have/has + S + V3.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: SINCE — qachon boshlangan: since 2012, since Monday, since I was a child (nuqta).
FOR — qancha davom etgan: for 20 years, for two hours, for a long time (davr).
Ikkalasi ham ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan: ish o'tganda boshlangan, hozir ham davom etyapti.
BECAUSE + Present Perfect: hozirgi holatning sababi o'tgan ishda — "She can't go because she has caught a cold".
formulas: S + have/has + V3 + since + boshlanish nuqtasi
I have lived there for 20 years.
Men u yerda 20 yildan beri yashayman.
How long have you known her?
She can't go to the party because she has caught a cold.
U bazmga bora olmaydi, chunki shamollab qolgan.
I haven't seen him since Monday.
It's two years since we got married.
presentation: How long have you known your best friend?
I have known him since primary school.
How long have your parents been married?
They have been married for twenty years.
Why can't Ali come to the wedding?
Because he has broken his leg.
How long has your sister been engaged?
She has been engaged for three months.
Since when have you lived in this flat?
Since 2020.
Why is she so happy?
Because she has just got engaged.
How long have they been on their honeymoon?
For a week.
Why can't you open the door?
Because I have lost my key.
How long has it been since the wedding?
It's been two years since the wedding.
Why isn't he at work?
Because he has gone on holiday.
notes: since + nuqta (yil, kun, soat, voqea); for + raqam + davr (days, weeks, years).
"since I was a child" — since'dan keyin butun gap Past Simple'da keladi.
"How long…?" ga javob: "for / since" bilan; "When…?" ga javob: Past Simple + vaqt.
because + Present Perfect — sabab hozir ta'sir qilyapti; because + Past Simple — sabab o'tgan, tugagan.
mistakes: I have lived here since three years.
I have lived here for three years.
How long do you know him?
How long have you known him?
She is tired because she works all day. (bugun)
She is tired because she has worked all day.

lessons.title: Yet, Still, Already, Just
lessons.grammar_topic: YET / STILL / ALREADY / JUST + PRESENT PERFECT
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 4 – Yet, still, already, just (jadval, C–D mashqlar, DEATH WORDS).
objectives: yet / still / already / just so'zlarining o'rni va ma'nosini bilish.
Present Perfect bilan "hali / haligacha / allaqachon / hozirgina" ma'nolarini ifodalash.
Motam mavzusidagi so'zlarni hurmatli ohangda ishlata olish (ta'ziya bildirish).
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 marta.
materials: Death (o'lim, motam — hurmat bilan) CORE 20 varag'i.
timeline: Ustoz: "Have you done your homework?" — javob variantlari doskada: "I have ALREADY done it" / "I haven't done it YET" / "I STILL haven't done it" / "I have JUST done it". Farqini his qildiring.
Kahoot — Since vs For, Because + Present Perfect
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Since vs For, Because + Present Perfect lug'ati
Kitob jadvali: YET (inkor va savol, gap oxirida) → STILL (inkor, have'dan oldin) → ALREADY (tasdiq, have bilan V3 orasida) → JUST (hozirgina, have bilan V3 orasida). Har biriga 2 misol + tarjima.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: YET — "hali": inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA. She hasn't bought anything yet. Has John bought a car yet?
STILL — "haligacha (kutilgan ish bo'lmadi)": inkorda, HAVE'DAN OLDIN. I still haven't called Yumi. (norozilik ohangi)
ALREADY — "allaqachon": tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA. I've already spent my salary.
JUST — "hozirgina": have va V3 ORASIDA. He has just gone out.
formulas: U hali hech narsa sotib olmadi.
Has John bought a new car yet?
Jon yangi mashina sotib oldimi hali?
presentation: Have you finished the book yet?
No, I haven't finished it yet.
Has the guest arrived yet?
Yes, he has just arrived.
Have you called your grandmother?
I still haven't called her. I'll do it tonight.
Has she sent the condolences?
Yes, she has already sent them.
What has he just said?
He has just said that the funeral is tomorrow.
Have they buried him yet?
Yes, they buried him this morning.
Have you eaten?
I have just eaten, thanks.
Has the film started yet?
It has already started. Hurry up!
Have you told your parents the news?
Not yet. I still haven't found the right words.
Has the doctor come?
She has just come.
notes: yet — gap oxirida; already/just — have va V3 orasida; still — have'dan oldin (inkorda).
"already" savolda ham bo'ladi (hayrat): "Have you already finished?!" — "Shunchalik tez tugatdingmi?!"
"still" tasdiq gapda Present Simple/Continuous bilan boshqa ma'no: "I still live here" — hali ham yashayman.
O'lim mavzusi: ingliz tilida "pass away" (vafot etdi) "die"dan yumshoqroq; ta'ziya: "I'm sorry for your loss" / "My condolences".

how: CORE 20 — kitobning DEATH WORDS ro'yxati (hurmatli ohang). STRONG — marosim va his-tuyg'u, SUPER — rasmiy/huquqiy so'zlar.
Ustoz ohangga e'tibor beradi: bu so'zlar ta'ziya va yangiliklarda kerak; hazil qilinmaydi.

He has just had a heart attack.

Uzoq kasallikdan so'ng u olamdan o'tdi.

U eridan keyin o'n yil yashadi.

U umri davomida ko'plarga yordam bergan.
normativ: Og'zaki: CORE 20 so'z + tarjima + gap, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin.
Yozma (keyingi darsda): 20 so'z, 5 daqiqa — 2 coin. STRONG/SUPER — +2 / +3 coin.

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS (have/has been + V-ing)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 5 – Present Perfect Continuous (jadval); Lesson 6 A mashqi; BODY WORDS (40); Reading Topic 1–10.
objectives: have/has been + V-ing qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzish.
"How long have you been …ing?" savoliga for/since bilan javob berish.
Tana a'zolari CORE 20 ni bilish va "My … has been hurting" qolipida ishlatish.
Reading: Topic 1 (A Restaurant for Change) — asosiy fikr va tafsilot savollari.
materials: Parts of the body (tana a'zolari) CORE 20 varag'i.
timeline: Ustoz derazadan tashqariga qarab: "It's wet. It has been raining." — o'quvchilar: "Why are you tired?" → "I have been working all day." Doskaga: have been + V-ing.
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Yet, still, already, just lug'ati
Kitob jadvali: Positive S+have/has+been+Ving → Negative haven't/hasn't been+Ving → Question Have/Has+S+been+Ving. Har qatorga misol + tarjima; "how long / for / since" bilan bog'lanadi.
Parts of the body (tana a'zolari) — CORE 20
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Present Perfect Continuous — ish o'tganda boshlangan va HOZIRGACHA davom etyapti (yoki hozirgina to'xtadi, izi ko'rinadi).
Urg'u — jarayon va davomiylik: "I have been waiting for two hours" (2 soatdan beri kutyapman).
Present Perfect esa natijaga urg'u beradi: "I have waited" (kutdim — tugadi). Farqi 6-darsda chuqur o'rganiladi.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, have=ega bo'lmoq, be) continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: "I have known him" (has been knowing — xato).
formulas: She hasn't been singing for a long time.
Have you been watching the games?
How long + have/has + S + been + V-ing?
How long have you been learning English?
… been + V-ing + for davr / since nuqta
It has been raining since morning.
I'm tired because I've been running.
presentation: How long have you been learning English?
I have been learning English for two years.

reading.title: Islam Makhachev — he has been training since he was ten
text: Islam Makhachev was born in 1991 in Dagestan. He has been training in wrestling and sambo since he was ten years old, and he has been friends with Khabib Nurmagomedov since childhood — they grew up in the same gym, with Khabib's father as their coach.

For many years Islam was "Khabib's friend". Since 2015 he has been fighting in the UFC, and he has been winning almost every fight. In 2022 he became the lightweight champion, and he has been defending the title ever since. Experts have been calling him the best fighter in the world.

His training day is hard on the body. He has been getting up at 6 am for years. He runs in the mountains, wrestles for two hours, and then works with his hands and legs in the gym. "My knees and my back have been hurting for ten years," he jokes, "but my head is fine."

Islam has been visiting Uzbekistan since 2019 and has many fans in Tashkent. He says the same thing to every young fighter: "Don't look for a shortcut. I have been working every day for twenty years — that is the only secret."
glossary: defend a title — unvonni himoya qilmoq

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT vs PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS (natija — jarayon)
lessons.test_after: PROGRESS TEST 1 — 1–6-darslar (Present Perfect oilasi, since/for, yet/still/already/just; narrative verbs, birth, marriage, death, body, clothes)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 6 – PP vs PPC (jadval, B/C mashqlar, 40 gap); CLOTHES (26); Reading Topic 11–20.
objectives: Present Perfect (natija, how many, tugagan) va PP Continuous (jarayon, how long, davom) farqini ajratish.
Bir vaziyat uchun ikkala zamonni to'g'ri tanlash (kitob B/C mashqlari).
Kiyim CORE 20 so'zlari bilan "I've been wearing / I've bought" gaplar.
Reading: Topic 20 — rasmiy xatda tajriba (I have spent / worked / completed).
Progress test 1 ga tayyorgarlik: 1–6-dars formulalari va lug'ati.
timeline: Ustoz ikki rasm: toza vanna ("You've cleaned the bathroom!") va tuproq qo'l ("I've been gardening"). Savol: qaysi birida NATIJA, qaysi birida JARAYON?
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Present Perfect Continuous lug'ati
Kitob jadvali 3 juft: natija — jarayon/davomiylik; how many — how long; tugagan ish — davom etishi mumkin bo'lgan ish. Har juftni yonma-yon doskaga, o'quvchi o'zi juft tuzadi.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: PRESENT PERFECT — NATIJA: "You've cleaned the bathroom! It looks lovely!" (toza — natija ko'rinadi).
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS — JARAYON va DAVOMIYLIK: "I've been gardening. It's so nice out there."
"How many?" → Present Perfect ("She's read ten books this summer"); "How long?" → PPC ("She's been reading that book all day").
Tugagan ish → PP ("I've written you an email"); davom etishi mumkin → PPC ("I've been writing emails").
Holat fe'llari (know, have, be, like) — faqat PP.

reading.title: Hasanboy Dusmatov — he has won everything, and he is still boxing
text: Hasanboy Dusmatov was born in 1993 in Andijan. He is small — only 1.60 metres — but he has been boxing since he was eight, and he has won more titles than almost any Uzbek athlete.

In 2016, in Rio, he won Olympic gold in the light flyweight division and was given the Val Barker Trophy — the prize for the best boxer of the whole Olympics. Since then he has been fighting at the highest level for years: he has won the Asian Games, the World Championships (2023) and a second Olympic gold in Paris (2024).

How has he been doing it for so long? Discipline. He has been wearing the same simple training clothes for years: a T-shirt, shorts and old trainers. "I don't need new sneakers to win," he says. He has been getting up at 5 am, running 10 km and then boxing for three hours — every day, for more than fifteen years.

He has also been helping young boxers in Andijan. A new boxing hall has opened there, and Hasanboy has been coaching children on Saturdays. "I have won a lot," he says, "but I have been learning something new every single day."

lessons.title: Comparative Degree
lessons.grammar_topic: COMPARATIVE (-er than / more … than / as … as)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 7 – Comparative degree (jadval, 45 gap, as…as 20 gap); ADJECTIVES OF APPEARANCE (47); Reading Topic 21–30.
objectives: Qisqa sifatlarga -er, uzunlariga more qo'shib "than" bilan taqqoslash.
as … as / not as … as bilan tenglik va farqni aytish.
good/bad/far istisnolarini bilish; much/a bit bilan kuchaytirish.
Tashqi ko'rinish CORE 20 bilan odamlarni tasvirlash va taqqoslash.
timeline: Ustoz ikki o'quvchini turg'izadi: "Who is taller?" — sinf javob beradi: "Ali is taller than Bobur." Keyin "Who is more talkative?" — ikki bo'g'inli sifat.
Kahoot — Progress test 1 natijalari + PP vs PPC
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Progress test 1 natijalari + PP vs PPC lug'ati
Kitob jadvali: 1 bo'g'in → adj+er+than; 2+ bo'g'in → more+adj+than; teng → as+adj+as. Imlo: big→bigger, happy→happier; istisno: good→better, bad→worse, far→further.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Bir bo'g'inli sifat: tall → taller than; big → bigger (undosh ikkilanadi); nice → nicer.
Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'in: more difficult than, more beautiful than. -y bilan tugagan: happy → happier, easy → easier.
Istisno: good → better, bad → worse, far → further, little → less, much/many → more.
Tenglik: as tall as; farq: not as tall as (= shorter than). Kuchaytirish: much taller, a bit taller, far more expensive.
formulas: Your house is bigger than ours.
Maths is more difficult than English.
X + be + as + adj + as + Y
My house is as old as your house.
X + be + not as + adj + as + Y
A lemon isn't as sweet as an orange.
My English is better than yours.
much / a lot / a bit + comparative
He is much taller than his brother.
presentation: Who is taller, you or your brother?
My brother is taller than me.
Is English more difficult than maths?
No, maths is more difficult than English.
Is your sister as tall as you?
Yes, she is as tall as me.

Tashkent is much bigger than Samarkand.

Yes, my hair is a bit longer than yours.

Yes, winter is much colder.
Is this phone better than the old one?
Yes, it's better and faster.
Is your friend as slim as you?
No, he isn't as slim as me.
Which city is further from here, Bukhara or Khiva?
Khiva is further than Bukhara.
notes: "than" dan keyin: than me / than I am — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; og'zaki nutqda "than me".
Ikki bo'g'inli, -y/-er/-ow/-le bilan tugaganlar -er oladi: happier, cleverer, narrower, simpler.
"as … as" inkori — "not as … as" yoki "not so … as".
Tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlash: He is tall and slim, with short dark hair. Taqqoslash: She looks younger than her sister.
mistakes: She is more tall than me.
She is as taller as me.
She is as tall as me.

how: CORE 20 — kitobning ADJECTIVES OF APPEARANCE ro'yxatidan (chiroyli/tana tuzilishi); STRONG — soch, yuz, uslub; SUPER — iboralar (have a … nose).

reading.title: Messi or Ronaldo — who is better?
text: For twenty years, football fans have argued about one question: who is better, Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo? Let's compare them.

Ronaldo is taller than Messi — 1.87 m against 1.70 m — and he is more muscular and more athletic. He is two years older, and he is faster in a straight line. Messi is shorter and slimmer, but he is quicker with the ball and more creative. Many coaches say Messi's left foot is more dangerous than any other foot in history.

Ronaldo has scored more goals than Messi — more than 900 — but Messi has given more assists and has won more trophies with his national team, including the World Cup in 2022. Ronaldo is more popular on social media: he has more followers than anyone else in the world. Messi is quieter and more modest; he doesn't talk as much as Ronaldo.

Their characters are different too. Ronaldo is more confident and more ambitious; he says, "I am the best." Messi is as talented as Ronaldo, but he is shyer and lets his game speak. As Ronaldo himself said: "We are not friends, but we are not enemies. We have made each other better." Uzbek fans are divided: in Tashkent you will find as many Messi shirts as Ronaldo shirts!

lessons.title: Superlative Degree
lessons.grammar_topic: SUPERLATIVE (the -est / the most …)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 8 – Superlative degree (jadval, A–C mashqlar); ADJECTIVES OF CHARACTER (71); Reading Topic 23.
objectives: the -est / the most bilan eng yuqori darajani tuzish; "in / of" bilan guruhni aytish.
Comparative va superlative'ni bir matnda to'g'ri almashib ishlatish (kitob B matni).
Xarakter sifatlari CORE 20 bilan odamlarni tasvirlash: "the most reliable person I know".
Reading: Topic 23 (rekordlar) — the most / the longest / the furthest.
timeline: "Who is the tallest in the class?" — hamma turadi, eng balandi topiladi. "Who is the most talkative?" — kulgi bilan.
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
Kitob jadvali: 1 bo'g'in → the + adj + est; 2+ bo'g'in → the most + adj. "in the world / in our class / of all" bilan. Istisno: the best, the worst, the furthest.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Superlative — uch va undan ko'p narsa ichida ENG: the tallest boy in the class.
1 bo'g'in: the + adj-est (the biggest — undosh ikkilanadi; the nicest). -y: the happiest.
2+ bo'g'in: the most + adj (the most beautiful). Istisno: the best, the worst, the furthest, the least, the most.
Superlative'dan keyin: in + joy/guruh (in the world, in our class), of + all (of all my friends). Ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan: "the best film I have ever seen".
formulas: Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
I'm the most curious man in the world.
the best / the worst / the furthest
She is the best student in our group.
He is the oldest of all.
the + superlative + I have ever + V3
This is the best film I have ever seen.
Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi kino.
Tashkent is one of the biggest cities in Asia.
Toshkent — Osiyodagi eng katta shaharlardan biri.
presentation: Who is the tallest in your family?

notes: Superlative'dan oldin har doim "the" (yoki my/his: my best friend).
Comparative — ikki narsa (than); superlative — uch va undan ko'p (the … in/of).
"the most" o'rniga "the least" — eng kam: the least expensive = the cheapest.
Xarakter so'zlarida juftlarni birga yodlang: reliable = trustworthy; hard-working = industrious; sociable = out-going.

reading.title: Abdukodir Khusanov — the most expensive Uzbek footballer ever
text: In January 2025, Manchester City paid 40 million euros for a 20-year-old defender from Tashkent. His name is Abdukodir Khusanov, and he became the most expensive Uzbek footballer in history — and the first Uzbek to play in the English Premier League.

Khusanov was born in 2004. His father was a professional footballer, and Abdukodir started at the Bunyodkor academy — one of the best football schools in Uzbekistan. At 18 he moved to Belarus, and a year later to Lens in France, where he became the most reliable defender in the team. Scouts called him the fastest and the strongest young defender in the league.

What is his character like? His coaches say he is the calmest player on the pitch and the most hard-working in training. He is also the most modest: after his first match for Manchester City he said, "I made mistakes, but I will learn." He is the youngest player in the team, and one of the most popular with the fans, who call him "Khusi".
For Uzbek teenagers he is the biggest football star of their generation. Thousands of boys in Tashkent now dream of the same road: the Bunyodkor academy today, the Premier League tomorrow.

lessons.title: Past Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: PAST PERFECT (had + V3) — o'tgandan ham oldin
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 9 – Past Perfect (jadval, 40 gap); HEALTH WORDS; Reading Topic 26.
objectives: had + V3 qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzish.
Ikki o'tgan ish ichida OLDINGISINI Past Perfect bilan ko'rsatish (by the time / when / before / after).
Sog'liq CORE 20 so'zlari bilan kasallik va davolanish haqida gapirish.
Reading: Topic 26 (Romeo va Juliet — baqalar) — voqealar tartibi.
timeline: Ustoz: "When I arrived at school this morning, the lesson had already started." Doskaga vaqt chizig'i: 1) lesson started 2) I arrived. Qaysi biri OLDIN?
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
Kitob jadvali: Positive S+had+V3 → Negative hadn't+V3 → Question Had+S+V3. "by 2020 / by the time / when / before / already" bilan; vaqt chizig'ida ikki o'tgan nuqta.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Past Perfect — o'tgan zamondagi ikki ishdan OLDINGISI: "By the time I arrived, they had already left" (ular ketgan — oldin; men keldim — keyin).
Formula: had + V3 (hamma shaxs uchun had). Qisqa: I'd, he'd, hadn't.
Ko'pincha: by (the time), when, before, after, already, never … before, just.
Faqat bitta o'tgan ish bo'lsa — Past Simple. Past Perfect faqat ikkinchi o'tgan nuqta bilan solishtirganda.
formulas: I had started my business by 2020.
I hadn't started my business by 2020.
Had you started your business by 2020?
By the time + Past Simple, S + had + V3
By the time I arrived, they had already left.
Men kelguncha ular allaqachon ketishgan edi.
She had never visited that city before her trip.
Sayohatidan oldin u o'sha shaharda hech bo'lmagan edi.
The store closed because they had sold everything.
Do'kon yopildi, chunki hamma narsani sotib bo'lishgan edi.
presentation: Had the lesson started when you arrived?
Yes, it had already started.
Why was she so tired yesterday?
Because she hadn't slept the night before.
Had you ever been to hospital before last year?
No, I had never been to hospital before.
What had the doctor done before you arrived?
He had already seen five patients.
Why did he go to the doctor?
Because his cough hadn't stopped for two weeks.
Had they finished the operation by 10 o'clock?
Yes, they had finished it by 9.30.
Why couldn't you get in?
Because I had left my key at home.
Had you taken the medicine before the pain went away?
Yes, I had taken two tablets.
What had happened before the ambulance came?
He had fallen off his bike.
Had she recovered by the weekend?
No, she hadn't recovered yet.
notes: Tartib aniq bo'lsa (first … then / after … before) og'zaki nutqda Past Simple ham yetadi; yozma va imtihonda Past Perfect ishlatiladi.
"after + Past Perfect, Past Simple": After I had taken the medicine, I felt better.
"when" bilan: When I got there, they had already started (oldin boshlagan).
Sog'liq bilan: had caught a cold, had broken a leg, had recovered, had taken medicine.
mistakes: By the time I arrived, they already left.
She had went to the doctor.
She had gone to the doctor.
Had you finished when I called? — Yes, I did.
Before she found her keys, she had search for hours.

how: CORE 20 — sog'liq va kasallik asosiy so'zlari; STRONG — kasalliklar va davolash; SUPER — tibbiy va sog'lom turmush iboralari (kitob ro'yxati).
Har so'zga Past Perfect gap: "By the time the doctor came, I had already taken the medicine."

reading.title: Eldor Shomurodov — the striker who had never given up
text: Eldor Shomurodov was born in 1995 in Jarkurgan, Surkhandarya. By the time he was 18, he had already played for Bunyodkor, and by 2017 he had moved to Russia. But the real story began in 2020, when Genoa in Italy bought him: he became the first Uzbek footballer in Serie A.

His first year in Italy was hard. Before he scored his first goal, he had missed many chances, and Italian newspapers had written that he was "not ready". Then he got injured: he had been playing with a knee problem for weeks, and doctors told him to stop. By the time he recovered, the season had almost ended.

In 2021 Roma bought him for 17 million euros — the biggest transfer for an Uzbek player at that time. Under coach José Mourinho he won the UEFA Conference League in 2022. Nobody from Uzbekistan had won a European trophy before him.

In 2025 Shomurodov did something even bigger: he scored the goals that took Uzbekistan to its first ever World Cup. "Before that match I hadn't slept for two nights," he said. "But I had promised my father that one day Uzbekistan would play at the World Cup. Now we will."

lessons.title: Future Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: FUTURE PERFECT (will have + V3) — kelajakdagi nuqtagacha tugagan ish
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 10 – Future Perfect (jadval, A–C mashqlar); EMOTIONS; Reading Topic 28.
objectives: will have + V3 qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzish.
"by + kelajak nuqta" bilan o'sha vaqtgacha tugaydigan ishni aytish.
Past Perfect (had) va Future Perfect (will have) ni vaqt chizig'ida solishtirish.
His-tuyg'u CORE 20 bilan kayfiyat va hissiyotni ifodalash.
timeline: Ustoz: "By 2030 I will have finished university. And you?" — har o'quvchi bitta "By 2030 I will have …" gapi aytadi.
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.

Kitob jadvali: Positive S+will have+V3 → Negative won't have+V3 → Question Will+S+have+V3. "by 2030 / by the time / by then / in ten years' time" bilan; vaqt chizig'i: hozir → ish tugaydi → kelajak nuqta.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Future Perfect — kelajakdagi bir nuqtaga kelib TUGAGAN bo'ladigan ish: "By 2030, I will have finished university."
Formula: will have + V3 (hamma shaxs). Qisqa: I'll have finished; won't have finished.
Ko'pincha: by + vaqt (by 2030, by Monday, by then), by the time + Present Simple ("by the time you arrive").
Past Perfect — o'tgan nuqtagacha (had); Future Perfect — kelajak nuqtagacha (will have). Ikkalasi ham "perfect" — tugallangan.
formulas: I will have finished university by 2030.
I won't have finished university by 2030.
Will you have finished university by 2030?
By the time + Present Simple, S + will have + V3
By the time you arrive, the film will have started.
S + will have + V3 + for + davr + by + vaqt
Next year they will have been married for 25 years.
Kelasi yil ular turmush qurganiga 25 yil bo'ladi.
It's 9 pm — she will have arrived home by now.
Soat 9 — u hozirgacha uyga yetib borgan bo'lsa kerak.
presentation: Will you have finished your homework by 8 o'clock?
Yes, I will have finished it by then.
What will you have achieved by 2030?

notes: "by" — "…gacha": by Monday, by the end of the year, by then, by the time (+ Present Simple, will emas!).
Future Perfect + for: "By June I will have worked here for five years."
Hozirgi taxmin uchun ham: "They will have arrived by now" (ehtimol yetib borishgan).
His-tuyg'u so'zlari: feel + sifat (feel anxious), be + sifat (be relieved), sabab bilan: "relieved because the exam will have finished".

reading.title: BTS — by 2030 they will have changed music forever
text: BTS is a group of seven singers from South Korea: RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook. They started in 2013, when almost nobody was excited about a small company from Seoul. Today they are the most popular music group in the world, and millions of their fans — the "ARMY" — live in Uzbekistan too.

Why do people love them? Because their songs are about real emotions: anxiety before exams, loneliness, fear of the future, and the joy of being young. "Love yourself," they tell their fans. In 2018 they spoke at the United Nations, and RM said: "No matter who you are, where you're from — speak yourself."

The members have been very open about their feelings. Suga has talked about depression; Jungkook has said he was nervous and embarrassed before his first concerts. Fans say this honesty makes them feel less lonely.

By 2030, BTS will have been together for 17 years. All seven will have finished their military service, and the group will have released new albums. Experts say that by then they will have sold more than 100 million records. And their fans in Tashkent are sure: by 2030, BTS will have played a concert in Uzbekistan!

lessons.title: Before, After, By the time, As soon as, Since
lessons.grammar_topic: BOG'LOVCHILAR: BEFORE / AFTER / BY THE TIME / AS SOON AS / SINCE
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 11 – Before, after, by the time, as soon as, since (jadval, B–D mashqlar, 20 gap); NATIONALITIES (46); Reading Topic 30.
objectives: Beshta vaqt bog'lovchisining har biri qaysi zamon juftligi bilan kelishini bilish.
Ikki gapni after/before bilan bitta gapga birlashtirish (Past Perfect + Past Simple).
by the time bilan Future Perfect va Past Perfect gaplar tuzish.
20 mamlakat va millat nomini to'g'ri yozish va aytish (bosh harf!).
materials: Countries and nationalities (mamlakat va millatlar) CORE 20 varag'i.
timeline: Ustoz 3 ish aytadi: "I woke up. I had breakfast. I came to school." — o'quvchilar "before / after / as soon as" bilan bog'laydi.
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.

Kitob jadvali 5 qator: BEFORE (Past Simple + Past Perfect), AFTER (Past Perfect + Past Simple), BY THE TIME (Present Simple + Future Perfect / Past Simple + Past Perfect), AS SOON AS (Past Simple + Past Simple / Present Simple + will), SINCE (Past Simple + Present Perfect). Kombinatsiya: before+after birga, by the time alohida, as soon as+since birga.
Countries and nationalities (mamlakat va millatlar) — CORE 20
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: BEFORE: Before + Past Simple, Past Perfect — "Before he visited Japan, he had never tasted sushi."
AFTER: After + Past Perfect, Past Simple — "After I had finished my work, I went for a walk."
BY THE TIME: By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect (kelajak) / By the time + Past Simple, Past Perfect (o'tgan).
AS SOON AS: As soon as + Past Simple, Past Simple — "As soon as I saw him, I ran." / kelajak: As soon as + Present Simple, will.
SINCE: Present Perfect + since + Past Simple — "I haven't seen her since we graduated."
formulas: Before + Past Simple, S + had + V3
Before he visited Japan, he had never tasted sushi.
Yaponiyaga borishidan oldin u hech qachon sushi yemagan edi.
After + S + had + V3, Past Simple
After I had finished my work, I went for a walk.
By the time + Present Simple, S + will have + V3
By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
Sen kelguncha men ovqat pishirib bo'laman.
By the time + Past Simple, S + had + V3
By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
As soon as + Past Simple, Past Simple
As soon as I finished, I called you.
S + have/has (not) + V3 + since + Past Simple
I haven't seen her since we graduated from college.
presentation: What had you done before you came to class?
Before I came to class, I had done my homework.
What did you do after you had finished school yesterday?
After I had finished school, I went to football.
Will you have eaten by the time I arrive?
Yes, by the time you arrive, I will have eaten.
What did you do as soon as you got home?
As soon as I got home, I turned on my phone.
How long have you known Ali?
I've known him since we were in primary school.
Had the bus left by the time you got to the stop?
Yes, it had left by the time I got there.
When will you call me?
I'll call you as soon as I finish.
Had you ever been abroad before you went to Turkey?
No, I had never been abroad before that.
Have you been to Samarkand since you moved here?
Yes, I've been there twice since I moved.
What will have changed by the time you are 30?
By the time I'm 30, I will have started my own business.
notes: after/before dan keyin -ing ham bo'ladi: After finishing my work, I went out.
"by the time" — bog'lovchi; "by" — predlog (by 2030). Ikkalasida ham perfect zamon.
as soon as = darhol, …bilanoq; kelajakda will yo'q: as soon as it stops (raining).
Millatlar: mamlakat ham, millat ham bosh harf bilan: Japan — Japanese; tilni ham: "She speaks Japanese".
mistakes: After I finished my work, I had gone out.
After I had finished my work, I went out.
after + oldingi ish (Past Perfect), keyingi — Past Simple.
By the time you will arrive…
As soon as I will finish, I'll call.
As soon as I finish, I'll call.
I haven't seen him since 3 years.
I haven't seen him for 3 years. / since 2023.

reading.title: Al-Farghani — the Uzbek scholar who measured the Nile
text: Ahmad al-Farghani was born around 800 in Fergana. In Europe he is known as Alfraganus. Before he became famous, he had studied in his home region; after he had finished his education, he moved to Baghdad, where the best scientists of the world were working at the House of Wisdom.

There he wrote "Elements of Astronomy". As soon as the book reached Europe, it became a textbook. It was translated into Latin in the 12th century, and by the time Columbus sailed to America in 1492, European sailors had been using Farghani's numbers for 300 years. Columbus himself read his book — and made a mistake with the units, which is why he thought the Earth was smaller than it is!

After Farghani had lived in Baghdad for many years, the ruler sent him to Egypt. There, in 861, he built the Nilometer in Cairo — an instrument to measure the level of the River Nile. Farmers used it to know when the water would rise. It still stands today; since it was built, it has been repaired many times, but the idea is the same.
Farghani died around 870. Today there is a monument to him in Fergana and another one in Cairo, next to the Nilometer — an Uzbek scholar between two countries, twelve centuries after his birth.

lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 12 – Past Perfect Continuous (jadval); WEATHER WORDS (44); Reading Topic 31; Audio 21–30.
objectives: had been + V-ing qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzish.
O'tgan nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayonni for/since/how long bilan aytish.

Ob-havo CORE 20 bilan iqlim va ob-havo haqida gapirish; listening: ob-havo ma'lumoti.
timeline: Ustoz: "When I came in, you had been talking for ten minutes!" — o'quvchilar: "Had we?" Doskaga vaqt chizig'i: talking (davom) → I came in.
Kahoot — Before / after / by the time / as soon as / since
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Before / after / by the time / as soon as / since lug'ati

Kitob jadvali: Positive S+had been+Ving → Negative hadn't been+Ving → Question Had+S+been+Ving. "by the time / when / for / since / how long" bilan. Present Perfect Continuous bilan solishtirish: has been waiting (hozirgacha) — had been waiting (o'sha paytgacha).
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Past Perfect Continuous — o'tgandagi bir nuqtagacha DAVOM ETGAN jarayon: "They had been waiting for hours by the time he came."
Formula: had been + V-ing. Qisqa: I'd been waiting; hadn't been.
Ko'pincha: for / since / how long / all day + by the time / when / before.
Farq: Past Perfect — natija (had finished); PPC — jarayon (had been working). Present Perfect Continuous — hozirgacha; Past Perfect Continuous — o'tgan nuqtagacha.
formulas: They had been waiting for hours by the time he came.
U kelguncha ular soatlab kutishgan edi.
She hadn't been waiting for hours by the time he came.
U kelguncha u soatlab kutmagan edi.
Had you been watching the games for an hour by the time they called?
Ular qo'ng'iroq qilguncha bir soat o'yin ko'rgan edingmi?
How long + had + S + been + V-ing?
How long had it been raining when you left?
Sen ketganingda qancha vaqtdan beri yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi?
Past Simple + because + had been + V-ing
The ground was wet because it had been raining.
Yer ho'l edi, chunki yomg'ir yog'ib turgan edi.
It has been snowing since morning. / It had been snowing for hours when we left.
Ertalabdan beri qor yog'yapti. / Biz ketganimizda soatlab qor yog'ib turgan edi.
presentation: How long had you been waiting when the bus came?
I had been waiting for twenty minutes.
Why was the ground wet this morning?
Because it had been raining all night.
Had it been snowing for long when you left?
Yes, it had been snowing since morning.

She had been crying.

Because it had been freezing all night.
What had you been doing before I called?
I had been watching the weather forecast.
How long had the storm been going on when the lights went out?
It had been going on for an hour.
notes: Holat fe'llari (know, have, be, like) — Past Perfect Simple: "I had known him for years".
"when" bilan: When I arrived, they had been waiting for an hour (jarayon oldin boshlangan).
Ob-havo gaplari: It had been raining / snowing / freezing … (it + had been + V-ing).
Forecast (prognoz) tinglaganda: sunny → rain → storm kabi ketma-ketlikka e'tibor.
mistakes: They had been wait for hours.
They had been waiting for hours.
It had rained for hours when we left. (jarayon)

I had been knowing him for years.
I had known him for years.
How long have you been waiting when the bus came?

She had been working here since three years.

reading.title: Lewis Hamilton — the race in the rain
text: Lewis Hamilton was born in 1985 in England. His father worked three jobs so that his son could race karts, and by the age of ten Lewis had been racing for four years. Today he has won seven Formula 1 world championships — more than anyone in history, together with Michael Schumacher.

Many of his greatest victories happened in bad weather. Drivers hate rain: the road is slippery, the tyres don't work, and visibility is almost zero. But Hamilton loves it. In Silverstone in 2008, it had been raining heavily for hours before the race started. Other drivers had been sliding off the track all morning. Hamilton won by more than a minute — the biggest gap in twenty years.

In Brazil in 2008, the situation was even more dramatic. It had been drizzling all afternoon, and in the last laps a downpour started. Hamilton had been driving in sixth place for a long time, but he needed fifth to become champion. On the final corner of the final lap, he passed one more car — and became the youngest champion in history at that time.
"I had been dreaming about that day since I was six," he said. Today, when the forecast says "rain", his fans smile: they know it is Hamilton weather.

intro: Future Perfect Continuous — kelajakdagi nuqtaga kelib QANCHA VAQT davom etgan bo'lishini aytadi: "By 2027 I will have been studying English for 3 years."
Formula: will have been + V-ing. Ko'pincha: by + vaqt / by the time + Present Simple + for + davr.
Perfect oilasi: Present Perfect (have V3) — PPC (have been Ving); Past Perfect (had V3) — PPC (had been Ving); Future Perfect (will have V3) — FPC (will have been Ving).
Qoida bitta: SIMPLE = natija/son; CONTINUOUS = jarayon/qancha vaqt.
formulas: I will have been studying English for 2 years by 2027.

Tushgacha 3 xat yozgan edim. / Sen qo'ng'iroq qilganingda 2 soatdan beri yozayotgan edim.
will have + V3 / will have been + V-ing
By 5 I will have written 3 letters. / By 5 I will have been writing for 3 hours.
5 gacha 3 xat yozib bo'laman. / 5 ga kelib 3 soatdan beri yozayotgan bo'laman.

I will have been learning it for three years.

notes: FPC kam ishlatiladi, lekin IELTS Writing/Speaking'da "By 2030 I will have been working…" chiroyli ball beradi.
"by the time" — Present Simple bilan (will emas); "by then" = o'sha vaqtga kelib.
Vaqt ifodalari: so far / lately / recently / yet → Present Perfect; by the time / before / when (o'tgan) → Past Perfect; by 2030 / by then → Future Perfect.
Progress test 2: 7–12 jadvallari (20 formula), 6 lug'atdan 40 so'z, 10 tarjima, 1 kichik matn.

reading.title: Cristiano Ronaldo — 25 years of football
text: Cristiano Ronaldo was born in 1985 on the island of Madeira, Portugal. His family was poor, and he had been playing football in the streets for years before a big club noticed him. At 12, he left his family and moved to Lisbon to train at Sporting. He has said that he cried every night at first because he missed his mother.

By the time he was 18, he had already signed for Manchester United. Since then, he has played for Real Madrid, Juventus and Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia. He has scored more than 900 goals in his career and has broken many records — more than anyone else in the history of the game.

Ronaldo is famous for his discipline. He has been training for more than five hours a day for over twenty years. He goes to bed early, eats very carefully and never gives up. "Talent without work is nothing," he says.

He has also been generous. He has given money to hospitals and children's charities, and he has visited sick children many times. Millions of young people in Uzbekistan follow him online — he has more followers on social media than any other person in the world.

By 2027, Ronaldo will have been playing professional football for 25 years. Will he have retired by 2030? Nobody knows — but by then he will have been an example for young players for a whole generation.

lessons.title: General vs Special Questions
lessons.grammar_topic: UMUMIY va MAXSUS SAVOLLAR (Yes/No — Wh-questions), barcha zamonlarda
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 14 – General vs special questions (jadval); CRIME WORDS; Reading — Jony Academy matni.
objectives: Yes/No savollarni barcha zamonlarda yordamchi fe'l bilan tuzish.
Wh-savollarni (what, where, when, why, who, how, how long, how many) to'g'ri tartibda tuzish.
"Who" ega bo'lganda yordamchi fe'lsiz savol (Who broke the window?).
Jinoyat CORE 20 bilan yangiliklar va detektiv suhbat tuzish.
timeline: Ustoz bir o'quvchi haqida "sirli" gap yozadi: "Somebody has taken my pen." — sinf savol beradi: "Did you leave it here? Who was near your desk? When did you last see it?" — detektiv o'yini.
Kahoot — Progress test 2 natijalari + Future Perfect Continuous
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — Progress test 2 natijalari + Future Perfect Continuous lug'ati

Kitob jadvali: General — yordamchi fe'l + S + V (Are you working? Do you speak? Will you go?); Special — savol so'zi + yordamchi + S + V (Where are you working? When do you speak? Why will you go?). Har zamon uchun yordamchi: do/does/did, am/is/are/was/were, have/has/had, will.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Umumiy savol (Yes/No): YORDAMCHI + EGA + FE'L: Do you live here? Has she called? Will they come?
Maxsus savol: SAVOL SO'ZI + yordamchi + ega + fe'l: Where do you live? Why has she called?
Yordamchi fe'l zamonga qarab: Present Simple — do/does; Past Simple — did; Continuous — am/is/are/was/were; Perfect — have/has/had; Future — will.
Ega savoli: Who / What + fe'l (yordamchisiz): Who stole the car? What happened?
formulas: Are you working? / Do you speak English? / Will you go with us?
Ishlayapsanmi? / Inglizcha gapirasanmi? / Biz bilan borasanmi?

presentation: Did you hear about the robbery last night?
Yes, I did. It was on the news.
Where did it happen?
It happened at the bank on Navoi Street.

No, they haven't caught them yet.

notes: Savol so'zlari: what, which, who, whom, whose, where, when, why, how, how long/many/much/often/far.
"Who" ega bo'lsa — yordamchi yo'q: Who called? Who stole it? Lekin ob'ekt bo'lsa: Who did you call?
Qisqa javob yordamchi bilan: Did he? — Yes, he did. / Has she? — No, she hasn't.
Yangiliklar tili: A man has been arrested. The police are looking for… Detektiv savollari: Where were you at 9 pm?

reading.title: Interview: Khabib Nurmagomedov — "Discipline is everything"
text: Khabib Nurmagomedov is one of the most famous fighters in the world. He was born in 1988 in Dagestan, Russia. He retired in 2020 with a perfect record: 29 wins and no losses. Here is a short interview with him.
Q: Did you always want to be a fighter? — A: Yes. My father was my coach. When I was a child, I trained with him every day. Everybody knows the video where I wrestled a bear at nine!
Q: Why did you retire so early? — A: Because I had promised my mother. After my father passed away in 2020, I didn't want to fight without him.
Q: Who was your hardest opponent? — A: Every opponent was hard. But the most famous fight was against Conor McGregor in 2018.
Q: What do you do now? — A: I coach young fighters. Islam Makhachev, my friend and student, has become a champion too.
Q: Have you ever been to Uzbekistan? — A: Yes, several times. Uzbek fans are very warm, and I love plov!
Q: What is your advice to young people? — A: Stay away from crime and bad company. Respect your parents. Train every day. Discipline is everything.

20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — General vs special questions lug'ati

Kitob jadvali: Type 2 — IF + Past Simple, S + would + V1 (hozirgi xayoliy); Type 3 — IF + Past Perfect, S + would have + V3 (o'tgan, o'zgarmas). Ikkala tartib: if-gap oldin (vergul) yoki keyin (vergulsiz).
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.

intro: Type 2 — HOZIR/KELAJAKDA xayoliy, real emas: "If I won the lottery, I would buy a mansion" (yutish ehtimoli kam).
Type 3 — O'TGANDA bo'lmagan, endi o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi: "If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam."
"were" hamma shaxs uchun rasmiy: If I were you… If she were here…
would o'rniga could/might: If I had time, I could travel. If they had left earlier, they might have caught the train.

If I won the lottery, I would buy a mansion.
Lotereya yutsam, katta uy sotib olardim.
S + would + V1 + if + Past Simple

If + Past Perfect, S + would have + V3
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
S + would have + V3 + if + Past Perfect
They would have caught the train if they had arrived on time.
If I were you, I would + V1
If I were you, I would book the ticket now.
Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, chiptani hozir olardim.

What would you do if you missed your flight?

reading.title: Ibn Sina — the traveller who wrote the book of medicine
text: Abu Ali ibn Sina — known in Europe as Avicenna — was born in 980 near Bukhara. He was a genius child: by the age of ten he had learned the whole Quran, and at sixteen he was already treating patients as a doctor. When the ruler of Bukhara fell ill, the young Ibn Sina cured him. As a reward, he was allowed to use the palace library — the biggest in the region.

But his life was not easy. When the Samanid state fell, Ibn Sina had to leave Bukhara. For the rest of his life he was a traveller: he lived in Khorezm, Gurganj, Rey, Hamadan and Isfahan. He often travelled at night, and he wrote his books on the road. Sometimes he was in prison; sometimes he was a minister.

His most famous book, "The Canon of Medicine", was the main medical textbook in Europe for 600 years. He described more than 700 medicines and was the first to explain that some diseases spread through water and air. He also wrote about philosophy, music, mathematics and astronomy — more than 450 works.

Ibn Sina died in 1037 in Hamadan. Today, his name is on hospitals, universities and streets all over Uzbekistan. If he had stayed in one city with a quiet life, would he have written so much? Perhaps not. If he were alive today, he would probably be a scientist, a doctor and a traveller at the same time.

lessons.title: During vs While, If vs Unless
lessons.grammar_topic: DURING vs WHILE; IF vs UNLESS
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 16 – During vs while, if vs unless (ikki jadval); FOOD AND DRINKS; Reading — MrBeast (Jony Academy matni).
objectives: during (+ ot) va while (+ gap/V-ing) farqini bilish.
if (agar) va unless (agar …masa) ni 1-tur shart gaplarda to'g'ri ishlatish.
unless = if … not almashtirishni bajarish.
Taom CORE 20 bilan retsept va restoran suhbati tuzish.
materials: Food and drinks (taom va ichimliklar) CORE 20 varag'i.
timeline: Ustoz: "During the lesson, don't eat. While I'm talking, listen." — savol: during'dan keyin nima keldi (ot), while'dan keyin nima (gap)? Keyin: "Unless you do your homework, no Kahoot!"
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.

Kitob jadvallari: DURING + ot (during the winter / during her vacation); WHILE + gap / V-ing (while I was cooking / while watching). IF = agar; UNLESS = agar …masa (= if not): I won't go outside unless it stops raining.
Food and drinks (taom va ichimliklar) — CORE 20
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: DURING + OT: during the winter, during the lesson, during her holiday. "Nima davomida?"
WHILE + GAP (S + V) yoki V-ing: while I was cooking; while cooking. "…yotgan paytda".
IF — agar (shart bo'lsa); UNLESS — agar …masa (shart bo'lmasa) = if … not. Unless'dan keyin inkor yo'q!
1-tur shart: If/Unless + Present Simple, will + V1. "Unless it stops raining, I won't go out."
formulas: During the winter, it snows a lot.
During her vacation in France, she learned French.
Fransiyadagi ta'tili davomida u fransuz tilini o'rgandi.
While + S + was + V-ing, S + was + V-ing
While I was cooking, she was cleaning the house.
Men ovqat pishirayotganimda u uyni tozalayotgan edi.
She fell asleep while watching the film.
If it rains, we'll stay indoors.
Unless + Present Simple, will + V1 (= if … not)
I won't go outside unless it stops raining.
presentation: What do you usually eat during the lesson break?
During the break I usually eat a snack.
What were you doing while your mum was cooking?
While she was cooking, I was setting the table.
Did you eat anything while watching the film?
Yes, I ate popcorn while watching it.
What will you cook if guests come?
If guests come, I'll cook plov.
Will you eat dessert unless you are full?
I'll eat dessert unless I'm too full.
When do you drink tea — during or after meals?
We drink tea during and after meals.
What happened while you were at the restaurant?
While we were eating, the lights went out.
Will you order pizza unless the café is closed?
Yes, unless it's closed, I'll order pizza.
Do you talk during dinner?
Yes, we talk a lot during dinner.
What will you do if the soup is too salty?
If it's too salty, I'll add water.
notes: during — predlog (ot bilan); while — bog'lovchi (gap bilan). "During I was cooking" — xato.
unless = if not: "Unless you hurry, you'll be late" = "If you don't hurry…"
unless'dan keyin inkor qo'yilmaydi: "unless it doesn't rain" — xato.
Taom so'zlari: meal (ovqatlanish vaqti), dish (taom), cuisine (oshxona uslubi), ingredient (masalliq).
mistakes: During I was eating, he called.
While I was eating, he called.
Unless you don't study, you'll fail.
If you will come, we'll eat.
I'll go unless it will rain.

reading.title: MrBeast — the YouTuber who feeds millions
text: Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, was born in 1998 in the USA. He started his YouTube channel at 13. During his teenage years, he made hundreds of videos, but almost nobody watched them. He didn't give up. While other teenagers were playing games, Jimmy was studying what makes a video popular.

In 2017 he became famous for a strange video: he counted to 100,000 — it took 40 hours! After that, his channel grew fast. Today he has more subscribers than any other YouTuber in the world, and millions of them are in Uzbekistan and Central Asia.

MrBeast is famous for giving money away. During his videos he gives cars, houses and even islands to ordinary people. But his biggest projects are about food. In 2020 he started Beast Philanthropy, a charity that gives free meals to families. It has already given away more than 30 million meals. He has also built wells in Africa so that villages have clean water, and he has paid for eye operations for 1,000 blind people.

"Unless you use your money to help people, it's useless," he says. He also owns a chocolate company, Feastables, and a burger restaurant chain. While filming, he often eats fast food — but he says he tries to eat healthy meals at home!

kahoot.q: ___ the lesson, please don't use your phone.
kahoot.explain: «the lesson» — ot. During + ot: during the lesson.

kahoot.q: ___ I was cooking, my brother was washing the dishes.
kahoot.explain: Keyin gap keladi (I was cooking) → While + ega + fe'l.

kahoot.q: She fell asleep ___ watching the film.
kahoot.explain: while + V-ing ham mumkin: while watching. during + V-ing — xato.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: Unless you don't eat, you'll be hungry.
Unless you eat, you'll be hungry.
If you don't eat, you'll be hungry.
You'll be hungry if you don't eat.
kahoot.explain: unless = if ... not. Undan keyin yana inkor qo'yilmaydi: Unless you eat...

kahoot.q: I won't go out ___ it stops raining.
kahoot.explain: Yomg'ir TO'XTAMASA chiqmayman → unless (= if it doesn't stop).

kahoot.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll eat inside.
kahoot.explain: If + Present Simple, will + V1. if-gapda will bo'lmaydi: If it rains...

kahoot.q: «Unless» ning ma'nosi qaysi?
kahoot.explain: unless = if ... not (agar ...masa): Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry.

kahoot.q: We'll order pizza unless the restaurant ___ closed.
kahoot.explain: unless + tasdiq, Present Simple: unless it is closed (yopiq bo'lmasa).

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Tushlik payti u menga qo'ng'iroq qildi.»
options: He called me during I had lunch.
kahoot.explain: «lunch» — ot, shuning uchun during lunch. while dan keyin gap keladi.

kahoot.q: DURING dan keyin nima keladi?
kahoot.explain: During + ot/ot birikma: during the winter, during the meal.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: While we were eating, the lights went out.
During we were eating, the lights went out.
While the meal, the lights went out.
During eating we were, the lights went out.
kahoot.explain: Gap (we were eating) oldidan while; ot (the meal) oldidan during.

kahoot.q: You won't lose weight ___ you eat less sugar.
kahoot.explain: Kamroq shakar YEMASANG ozmaysan → unless (= if you don't eat less).

kahoot.q: At the end of the meal, we asked the waiter for the ___.
kahoot.explain: bill — restorandagi hisob. menu — menyu (ovqat oldidan so'raladi).

kahoot.q: Ice cream is a popular ___ after the main course.
kahoot.explain: dessert — shirinlik (oxirida). starter — ishtahaochar (boshida).

kahoot.q: First, ___ up the onions into small pieces.
kahoot.explain: chop up — maydalab to'g'ramoq. heat up — isitmoq, fill up — to'ldirmoq.

kahoot.q: Food that is not cooked is ___.
kahoot.explain: raw — xom. fried — qovurilgan, boiled — qaynatilgan, grilled — panjarada.

kahoot.q: «masalliq» — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: ingredient — masalliq. recipe — retsept, nutrient — ozuqa moddasi.

kahoot.q: Plov is a famous ___ of Uzbek cuisine.
kahoot.explain: dish — taom (bitta ovqat turi). diet — parhez.

kahoot.q: The food is ready. Let's dig ___!
kahoot.explain: dig in — ovqatni boshlamoq (yeyishga kirishmoq).

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z «crispy» ga ma'nodosh?
kahoot.explain: crispy = crunchy — qarsildoq. creamy — qaymoqli, yumshoq.

lessons.title: Indirect vs Direct Questions
lessons.grammar_topic: BILVOSITA SAVOLLAR (Could you tell me… / Do you know… / I wonder…)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 17 – Indirect vs direct questions (jadval); AT SCHOOL WORDS; Reading — Al-Xorazmiy (Jony Academy matni).
objectives: Bilvosita savol iboralarini bilish: Could you tell me / Do you know / I wonder / I'd like to know / Can you remember.
Wh-savolni bilvosita shaklga o'tkazish (so'z tartibi gapdek; do/does/did yo'q).
Yes/No savolni if / whether bilan bilvosita qilish.
Maktab CORE 20 bilan fanlar, xonalar va jihozlar haqida muloyim savollar berish.
timeline: Ustoz notanish odam rolida: "Where is the library?" (qo'pol) — "Excuse me, could you tell me where the library is?" (muloyim). Farq: so'z tartibi va ohang.
Kahoot — During vs while, if vs unless
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — During vs while, if vs unless lug'ati

Kitob jadvali: Direct — Question word + Auxiliary + S + Verb? (What time does the movie start?); Indirect — Phrase + Question word + S + Verb (Could you tell me what time the movie starts?). Yes/No savolda if/whether. Yordamchi do/does/did yo'qoladi; tartib gapdek.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Yangi grammatika bilan 5 gap (yozma) yoki 1 daqiqa og'zaki.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: Bevosita: "Where is the gym?" — bilvosita: "Could you tell me where the gym is?" — ega fe'ldan OLDIN, savol tartibi yo'q.
Present/Past Simple'da do/does/did yo'qoladi: "When does the lesson start?" → "Do you know when the lesson starts?"
Yes/No savol → if / whether: "Is the library open?" → "Do you know if the library is open?"
Oxiridagi belgi: ibora savol bo'lsa (Could you tell me…?) — "?", gap bo'lsa (I wonder…) — ".".
formulas: What time does the movie start?
Could you tell me what time the movie starts?
Do you know where the library is?
Do you know if the lab is open today?
I wonder why the teacher is late.
Can you remember what the homework was?

notes: Muloyim so'rov iboralari: Could you tell me…? / Do you know…? / Would you mind telling me…? / I'd like to know… / I wonder…
"whether" rasmiyroq, "if" og'zaki — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
Bilvosita savolda "will" qoladi: Do you know when the bus will come?
Maktab so'zlari: subject (fan), facility (sharoit), supplies (jihoz), staff (xodimlar).

reading.title: Al-Khwarizmi — the father of algebra
text: Do you know where the word "algorithm" comes from? It comes from the name of a scientist who was born in Khorezm, in today's Uzbekistan, around the year 780. His name was Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi.

Al-Khwarizmi worked in Baghdad at the House of Wisdom — the biggest library and research centre of its time. Scholars from many countries worked there, and the ruler paid them to translate and write books. Al-Khwarizmi wrote a book called "Al-Jabr", and this is where the word "algebra" comes from. In the book he explained how to solve equations step by step. Before him, nobody had written such clear rules.

He also wrote a book about Indian numbers — 1, 2, 3 … and zero. Europeans learned these numbers from his book, and that is why we call them "Arabic numerals" today. Without them, there would be no computers, no phones and no internet. Every time you use a calculator, you are using his ideas.

Al-Khwarizmi also made a map of the world and a table of the positions of stars. He died around 850. Today, if you ask a mathematician who the father of algebra is, they will tell you: Al-Khwarizmi from Khorezm. There is a monument to him in Khiva and Urgench, and a crater on the Moon is named after him.
glossary: be named after — nomi bilan atalmoq

lessons.title: Wish Sentences
lessons.grammar_topic: WISH (+ Past Simple / Past Continuous / Past Perfect / would / could / to-infinitive)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 2.0: Lesson 18 – Wish sentences (6 qatorli jadval); SHOPPING WORDS; Reading — Elon Musk (Jony Academy matni); Audio 41–50.
objectives: wish + Past Simple / Past Continuous bilan hozirgi afsusni aytish.
wish + Past Perfect bilan o'tgan afsusni aytish.
wish + would (norozilik) va wish + could (imkoniyat) farqini bilish.
Xarid CORE 20 bilan do'kon, chegirma va onlayn xarid haqida gapirish.
timeline: Ustoz: "I wish I had a million dollars. I wish it were Friday. I wish I hadn't eaten so much." — o'quvchilar har biriga "Me too!" yoki o'z wish'i.
20 savol, 15 soniya; oldingi dars lug'ati + grammatikasi.

Kitob jadvali 6 qator: hozirgi holat → wish + Past Simple; hozir bo'layotgan → wish + Past Continuous; o'tgan → wish + Past Perfect; boshqa odam/narsa o'zgarsin → wish + would; qila olsam → wish + could; xohlamoq (rasmiy) → wish + to V.
Har so'z bilan yangi grammatika qolipida gap.
Kitob: formula → gap → tarjima; warm-up / normativ / coin me'yorlari.
Sinf matni + 3 topshiriq; kitob Topic'lari uyga.
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada; STRONG lug'at kuchlilarga.

intro: I wish + Past Simple — HOZIR boshqacha bo'lishini xohlash: "I wish I had a big house" (uyim yo'q). "were" hamma uchun: I wish I were taller.
I wish + Past Continuous — hozir bo'layotgan ish boshqacha bo'lsa: "I wish it were raining right now."
I wish + Past Perfect — O'TGANNI o'zgartirish (bo'lmaydi): "I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake."
I wish + would — boshqa odam/narsa o'zgarishini xohlash (norozilik): "I wish he would stop interrupting me."
I wish + could — qila olmagan narsani qila olsam: "She wishes she could travel." I wish + to V = want (rasmiy): "I wish to speak with the manager."
formulas: I wish I had a big house. / I wish I were taller.
Qaniydi katta uyim bo'lsa. / Qaniydi balandroq bo'lsam.
I wish it were raining right now.
I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake.
I wish he would stop interrupting me.
She wishes she could travel around the world.
Qaniydi u dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qila olsa.
I wish to speak with the manager.
